name: Bookstore Reading and Conceptualization Journey
description: Sun Yuwei changed her clothes, slung a canvas bag over her shoulder, and headed out. She walked for 8 minutes to the "Longquan Road" bus stop, took the No. 84 bus for about 25 minutes, and got off at the "Xuefu Road" stop. After a 3-minute walk, she arrived at the Sanlian Taofen Bookstore. On the second-floor reading area, she ordered a cup of ripe Pu'er tea and read *Memories of Kunming's Old Streets and Alleys* and *In Search of the City* to find inspiration for her prose. She noted down the moments that moved her and refined the financial journal pages she had worked on in the morning. Closing the book, she fell into deep thought, and the framework for her family-themed essay gradually became clear: using "Grandma's Rice Noodle Stall" and "Father's Old Bicycle" as key threads. Later, she purchased *Memories of Kunming's Old Streets and Alleys* and walked to the nearby Huaxin Stationery Store to buy a light gray, subtly patterned letter paper notebook and a fine-nib fountain pen. For the return trip, she took the No. 84 bus back the same way and picked up a package containing a new silent keyboard at the Cainiao Station near her residential complex.

name: Dinner Preparation and Family Communication

Sun Yuwei replied to confirm that she would handle it later. I then went into the kitchen to help my mother prepare dinner (stir-fried pea shoots and braised eggplant), and naturally steered the conversation toward interviewing her about details of our family's past. I recorded key information using the voice memo app on my phone. During dinner, I shared my essay ideas and the snippets I had heard with my parents. My father added a story about riding a bicycle, completing the natural interview.

After the break, continued writing the second layer of the article, weaving literary details of family memories (such as the lintel of the old house) into the description.

She sat by the window, watching the flowing street scenes outside, and began to contemplate the subtle sounds and lights in the "Soy Milk Shop." location: No. 343 Longquan Road, Yunda Residential Area, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province, China

name: Focusing on creating "The Morning Soy Milk Shop" at Mingyuan Bookstore.
description: Sun Yuwei settled into a seat by the window on the second floor of Mingyuan Bookstore, ordered a cup of hot Pu’er tea, and opened her laptop and journal. She reviewed the opening passage of "The Warmth of the Old Street" and her notes from the photography exhibition, which she had written the day before, then immersed herself in the world of the "soy milk shop." She meticulously described the clattering sound of beans being poured into a stone mill, the puffing noise of steam lifting the lid of the pot, the gentle, prolonged sound of the stall owner stirring the soy milk with a long ladle, and the hazy pillars of light formed by the first rays of sunlight piercing through the steam. Midway through her writing, Qin Mingyuan (Uncle Qin), the bookstore owner, quietly refilled her hot water. Seeing her focused expression, he smiled and nodded in acknowledgment. By nearly noon, she had completed the main part of the first draft of this scene, feeling a sense of fulfilling exhaustion.
location: Mingyuan Bookstore, located on the northeast side of the intersection of Wenlin Street and Tianjundian Lane, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province.

Uncle Qin took out a notebook of miscellaneous notes he had collected in his early years about the sounds of old Kunming's streets and lent it to Sun Yuwei for reference, agreeing to discuss it in detail and return it next time. After saying goodbye, she walked for about five minutes to Culture Lane for a meal.
location: Mingyuan Bookstore, Northeast Corner of the Intersection of Wenlin Street and Tianjundian Lane, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

At the 'Toread' store, after trying on and comparing different pairs, she chose a pair of lightweight, slip-resistant hiking shoes. During her shopping break, she confirmed the decoration style of the commemorative album with her mother via WeChat and asked her sister to help brainstorm ideas for the blessing message. Afterwards, she walked about 12 minutes to Culture Lane to meet Li Ming, a senior from the photography club, at a café. The senior brought the mirrorless camera he had promised to lend her for the hiking event. She showed him the hiking shoes she had purchased. Amid the aroma of coffee, the senior helped her review the basic operation modes of the camera, focusing techniques, and key points of composition. She tried taking a few photos to ensure she could use the camera proficiently on the day of the event. When parting, she gave the senior a prepared pour-over coffee drip bag as a token of gratitude. Later, she walked about 17 minutes back to the area near Golden Eagle Shopping Center and had a simple lunch of Cross-Bridge Rice Noodles at the food court. After the meal, she walked about 10 minutes to Hang Lung Plaza, where she carefully selected scrapbooking materials at 'Jiumu Sundry Shop.' She bought several retro-style and nature-themed stickers and washi tapes, planning to use them to decorate her father’s birthday commemorative album.

Then, drawing from her recent visits to independent bookstores in Kunming, she started drafting a chapter for her essay on urban landscapes and bookstore culture. During breaks in her writing, she observed the quiet readers in the bookstore. Midway through, Qin Mingyuan (Uncle Qin), the bookstore owner, came over to refill her water. The two briefly exchanged thoughts on "the representation of local culture in contemporary writing," with Uncle Qin sharing some of his insights, which she carefully noted down. She continued refining her article and later responded to an email from her editor, Xu Mingyuan, confirming the theme for next month's column.

The parents listened with great interest, offering encouragement and advice once again.
location: Home Restaurant in Yunda Residential Area, No. 343 Longquan Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

location: Yunnan Province, Kunming City, Wuhua District, Longquan Road No. 343, Yunda Residential Area, Bedroom at Home

In her journal, she summarized the day: completed financial records and refined the travel budget, prepared for hiking, made progress on the scrapbook, and engaged in inspired writing at the bookstore. Finally, she opened a new page and wrote down her anticipation for the trip to Dali: "Cangshan Mountain and Erhai Lake—a new chapter of words and light."
location: No. 343 Longquan Road, Yunda Residential Area, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province, China - Kitchen and Study in the Home

She pulled her suitcase, slung her backpack over her shoulders, and took a pre-booked ride-hailing car, a journey of about 25 minutes to Kunming Railway Station. Upon arriving at Kunming Railway Station, she passed through security and entered the waiting hall. Finding the corresponding waiting area, she sat down to rest. Watching the diverse travelers around her, she felt full of anticipation for the journey ahead. To avoid aggravating her back discomfort from sitting too long, she occasionally got up and walked around.
location: No. 1 Beijing Road, Guandu District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province, Waiting Hall of Kunming Railway Station

She places her suitcase on the luggage rack and her backpack on the inner side of the pillow. After tidying up her berth and changing into comfortable clothes, the train slowly departs from Kunming Station. Leaning against her bunk, she listens to the rhythmic clatter of the wheels against the rails, reflecting on the changes over the past two weeks: from an excellent thesis defense, receiving manuscript fees, planning her finances, and having a heartfelt conversation with her advisor, to now embarking on this journey. Her heart is filled with anticipation for the future, but a slight discomfort in her back reminds her to rest. She puts on her headphones, listens to some soothing light music for a while, and prepares to fall asleep. Status: On a train heading to Dali, feeling excited and serene but with slight back discomfort.
location: Night train hard sleeper compartment to Dali.

name: Morning Awakening and First Impressions of the Inn

Waking up in the inn room, my back still felt a faint ache from the long journey. Pushing open the wooden window, I breathed in the moist, fresh air, observed the staggered lines of the ancient town's gray-tiled roofs, and recorded my first impressions of Dali in my journal.

Amidst a mix of exhaustion and contentment, I gradually drifted into sleep.

name: Morning Wake-up and Gentle Stretching
description: Waking up in the morning light that alternated between clouds and sunshine, the deep soreness in my back from yesterday's hike felt even clearer than last night. Slowly turning to get out of bed, I performed about 8 minutes of gentle stretches for my shoulders, neck, and back on the bedside rug (recalling the movements taught by yoga instructor He Lu). Afterward, I washed up and changed into a set of soft cotton loungewear.
location: In the bedroom of the home in Yunda Residential Area, No. 343 Longquan Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province, China.

name: Having breakfast with parents
description: Mother prepared small pot rice noodles and fermented tofu. While having breakfast, I explained in detail to my parents the reaction of my back muscles after yesterday's hike, emphasizing that I needed to rest at home today and cancel any plans to go out. My parents expressed their understanding, with my father urging me to rest more and my mother suggesting a hot compress in the afternoon. We also chatted about the weekend market happenings.

name: Taking a walk in the neighborhood for fresh air
description: To stretch my sore and stiff limbs without overexerting myself, I decided to take a slow walk within the residential complex. Starting from the entrance of my building, I strolled along the internal roads to the central garden. I stood by the pond for a while, watching the koi fish and observing the elderly practicing tai chi during their morning exercise. After breathing in the fresh, plant-scented air for about ten minutes, I leisurely made my way back home. (Mode of travel: walking, round trip duration approximately 15 minutes)
location: No. 343 Longquan Road, Yunda Residential Area, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province, including internal roads and the central garden.

name: Launching the "Handwritten Journal Footsteps" Column
description: Sitting at the desk, I deliberately placed a memory foam cushion behind my lower back. First, I imported the photos taken with the mirrorless camera during yesterday’s hike into the computer, carefully selecting the 12 most storytelling shots (the shimmering ripples of Cuihu Lake, the play of light and shadow on the walls of Yingqiu Courtyard at Yunnan University, the elongated silhouettes of fellow hikers, and a serendipitous snapshot of a cat on a windowsill). I printed them out using a portable photo printer. Then, I solemnly opened my journal, affixing a self-made "Trail Log #1" label at the top of a fresh page. With meticulous layout, I arranged the photos in an artful, staggered pattern, using pens and highlighters of various colors to annotate in detail: the time of capture, precise location, lighting conditions, air humidity, physical sensations ("right calf began to ache here," "took a deep breath, caught the scent of osmanthus"), and fleeting thoughts. This is not merely a record but a way of transforming an outdoor experience into a rich archive of text and images to be savored time and again.
location: Home study in Yunda Residential Area, No. 343 Longquan Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: Assist in preparing lunch
description: I walked into the kitchen and helped my mother pick the pea tips and cut the tomatoes. She made pea tip tofu soup and stir-fried pork slices with green peppers, both of which had a light flavor. During lunch, I took the initiative to show my mother the "Footprints" column I had completed that morning. She listened with great interest to the details behind each photo and marveled at how observant her daughter was.
location: No. 343 Longquan Road, Yunda Residential Area, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province, China – Kitchen and Dining Room in the Home

name: Nap and Reading
description: Drowsiness crept in after the meal. Leaning against the headboard, I read about 30 pages of Chen Chunsheng’s *The Night of the Submarine*, deeply captivated by the depiction of concealment and memory in *The Bamboo Peak Temple*, temporarily forgetting the discomfort in my back. Then I set the book aside, drew the blackout curtains, and took a short nap for 20 minutes.
location: In the bedroom of the home at Yunda Residential Area, No. 343 Longquan Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province, China.

name: Handling writing and drafting matters
description: Feeling a bit refreshed after the noon break. I turned on the computer to check my email, replying to editor Xu Mingyuan’s confirmation regarding the layout of my previous book review manuscript, and briefly discussing the direction for the next topic. Afterwards, I sent a few of my favorite photos from the "Footprints" column to my close friend Zhang Jing and online book enthusiast Yang Xiao, briefly sharing my insights on capturing light and shadow during the shoot over WeChat.
location: Home Study in Yunda Residential Area, No. 343 Longquan Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province, China

name: Organizing dormitory items in the cloud
description: Initiated a WeChat video call with Zhao Xiaowen, the roommate who stayed at school. Wenwen held up her phone, touring the dormitory like a guide, the camera sweeping over Sun Yuwei's bookshelf, wardrobe, and under-bed storage boxes. As they chatted about recent happenings, they made remote decisions: Wenwen picked up an item and showed it, "Do you want this sweater?" "Yes, put it in the 'take home' box." "What about this stack of freshman-year general course notes?" "Take photos of the key pages for keepsakes, then dispose of them." Sun Yuwei updated the categorized list on her computer in real-time. When Wenwen pulled out a faded movie ticket stub (from watching "Myth of Love" together in junior year) and a tile cat pendant brought back from Dali Ancient Town, engraved with "peace," both of them laughed simultaneously, reminiscing about the moment through the screen. The entire process was relaxed and pleasant—an online sorting and emotional farewell to the material possessions and memories of the past three years, completely avoiding any physical strain.
location: Home Study, Yun Da Residential Area, No. 343 Longquan Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province, China

name: Back Hot Compress Care
description: After the "cloud tidying" session, the soreness in my back became noticeable again due to prolonged sitting. Following my mother’s advice strictly, I soaked a towel in hot water, wrung it out, and applied it to the most tense area of my back for 15 minutes. At the same time, I put on headphones and played a pure music playlist called "Mountain Forest Healing" on repeat. Closing my eyes to rest, I felt the tight muscles gradually relax.
location: No. 343, Longquan Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province, Yunda Residential Area, Bedroom in the Home

name: Search for old photos in father's memorial album.
description: After the hot compress, I felt much more comfortable. I remembered my father's birthday next month and planned to create a family commemorative album. So, my mother and I brought out several thick old photo albums and spread them out on the living room coffee table. My mother found photos of my father winning a speech contest at the cultural bureau when he was young, pictures of them by Dianchi Lake during their early days of dating, and a family portrait of me riding on my father's shoulders as a child. Sun Yuwei carefully took photos of them with her phone and asked my mother to narrate the stories behind each picture. She quickly recorded the time, location, and keywords in her phone's memo app to use as material for writing captions later.
location: No. 343, Longquan Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province, in the living room of the residential area of Yunda Community.

name: Assist in preparing dinner
description: I walked into the kitchen to help wash the rice and cook it, and then cleaned the green bamboo shoots and mushrooms for dinner. While chatting with my mother about the fun of looking through old photos in the afternoon, she sighed over how quickly time flies.
location: Yunnan University Residential Area, No. 343 Longquan Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province, Kitchen in the Home

name: Having dinner with family
description: During dinner, Sun Yuwei shared the amusing story of video chatting with Wenwen in the afternoon to "organize" their dorm, especially the discovery of those small keepsakes filled with memories. Her father listened with great interest and also shared his own story of giving a box of books to a junior student when he cleaned out his dorm after graduating from university. Her mother then reminded her that any books she couldn't take with her upon graduation could be donated to the school's public welfare club.
location: Home Dining Room in Yunda Residential Area, No. 343 Longquan Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province, China

location: No. 343 Longquan Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province, in the kitchen and living room of the home in the Yunda Residential Area.

name: Create a graduation trip budget sheet
description: Returning to the study, I turned on the computer and opened Excel. Drawing from my recent firsthand spending experiences in Dali, real-time quotes from various travel apps, and the preliminary ideas discussed in the "Graduation Trip Squad" WeChat group, I began creating a detailed budget sheet. Major categories were established: round-trip bullet train tickets between Kunming and Dali, three nights of homestay accommodation, daily meal budgets, transportation around Erhai Lake (electric scooter rental), entrance fees for attractions like the Three Pagodas of Chongsheng Temple, souvenirs, and a shared emergency fund of 200 yuan per person. After repeated calculations, I ensured the total expenses were strictly kept within the per capita limit of 1,500 yuan. Once completed, I generated a clear, long screenshot of the table, sent it to the WeChat group, and added the message: "Draft is ready, please review and share your thoughts, bosses!"
location: Home Study, Yunda Residential Area, No. 343 Longquan Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province, China

name: Book Dali bullet train tickets
description: Based on the travel dates determined in the budget sheet (referring to the preferences discussed in the group chat), I simultaneously opened the official 12306 app and the Ctrip Travel app to carefully compare the bullet train schedules, ticket prices (second-class seats), and seat availability for different departure times from Kunming Station to Dali Station. After considering both the comfort of the departure time and the price, I ultimately selected two trains: one for the outbound journey (departing around 8:00 AM) and one for the return journey (departing around 3:00 PM). I initiated a quick vote in the WeChat group, and after receiving unanimous agreement from my roommates, I immediately booked and paid for my ticket on the 12306 app. Upon receiving the confirmation SMS for the successful ticket purchase, I promptly shared a screenshot of the order in the group chat and tagged everyone, saying, "Tickets are sorted, my part is done! Please purchase the same train as soon as possible."
location: Home Study Room, Yunda Residential Area, No. 343 Longquan Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province, China

name: Keeping a journal and washing up before bed
description: Summarizing this day of "organization and planning" in my journal: I highlighted the ceremonial sense of starting the "Footsteps" column, the warm memories that surfaced during the "cloud organizing" session with Wenwen, the careful budgeting involved in creating the budget sheet, and the reassuring feeling of "plans coming to fruition" after successfully booking tickets. I also briefly noted the backache and its relief after applying a warm compress. Afterward, I followed a meticulous bedtime routine of washing up and skincare.
location: In the bedroom of the home at Yunda Residential Area, No. 343 Longquan Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province, China.

I focused on stretching, paying special attention to my back, hips, and legs. After the stretching, I felt physically relaxed and mentally calm. After checking the alarm for the next day, I turned off the lights and fell asleep around 22:50, surrounded by the gentle scent of lavender essential oil.
location: In the bedroom of the residence at Yunda Residential Area, No. 343 Longquan Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province, China.

Later, I took a leisurely stroll along the pedestrian paths within the Yunda residential community and beside Longquan Road, replacing my usual brisk walk. I observed elderly people doing morning exercises, primary school students heading to school, and the quiet blue snowflakes and azaleas in the roadside flower beds, which appeared serene under the overcast sky. Along the way, I encountered Aunt Xie Xiulan, a neighbor returning from grocery shopping, and we exchanged brief greetings. She kindly reminded me to take care of my health.
location: Yunnan University Residential Area, 343 Longquan Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province, bedroom in the home; internal roads of Yunnan University Residential Area and the sidewalks along Longquan Road.

After the meal, I returned to the study, turned on the computer, and handled work emails: I confirmed the schedule with editor Xu Mingyuan regarding the manuscript "The Scent of Old Books in the Alleys of Spring City"; I also responded to an inquiry from a new media platform about a long-term invitation to contribute to a life essay column.
location: Yunnan University Residential Area, No. 343 Longquan Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province, China - Home Dining Room and Study

Scattered books were sorted and returned to their respective categories, such as literary theory, modern and contemporary essay collections, and writing reference books. Stationery items like fountain pens, colored pens, sticky notes, and washi tape were neatly arranged in drawer organizers. I carefully wiped away the dust from the desktop and the shelves. The entire process was carried out at a relaxed pace, with breaks every 30 minutes to stand up, stretch, and perform gentle back exercises. After finishing, I felt a sense of clarity and lightness.
location: Home study in Yunda Residential Area, No. 343 Longquan Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province, China.

I finally settled on the courtyard double room at "Cang Er Xiao Zhu" because the reviews mentioned "the owner loves books" and "extremely quiet at night." I completed the online booking and payment. location: Home study in Yunda Residential Area, No. 343 Longquan Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province, China.

After the meal, I returned to my bedroom for a short 20-minute nap. Upon waking, I leaned against the headboard and freely read a passage from the book "Moments of Flora Between Cangshan Mountain and Erhai Lake," which I brought back from Dali, describing the wetland plants of Erhai Lake.
location: Yunnan Province, Kunming City, Wuhua District, Longquan Road No. 343, Yunda Residential Area, home kitchen, dining room, and bedroom.

location: No. 343, Longquan Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province, Yunda Residential Community, living room in the home

name: Participating in the elective course "Modern Prose Studies"
description: Attending the elective course "Modern Prose Studies" in Room 306 of Wenyuan Building at Yunnan University's Donglu Campus. The theme of this class was "Local Writing and Detail Presentation in Contemporary Prose," delivered by Professor Wu Mingyuan, who provided in-depth analysis of texts by writers such as Wang Zengqi, A Cheng, and Li Juan. Sun Yuwei listened attentively, meticulously noting down key terms such as "regionality," "everyday epic," "the granularity of details and emotional restraint," and "the perspective of observation determines the depth of writing." These concepts sparked reflections and connections to her own writing and the lecture she would attend in the evening. During the break, she briefly exchanged notes with a neighboring classmate.
location: Classroom 306, Wenyuan Building, Donglu Campus, Yunnan University, No. 2 Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province, China

name: Prepare and listen to the online non-fiction writing lecture.
description: Making final preparations for the online lecture in the home study: checking equipment and internet connection, opening a notebook, preparing a pen, silencing the phone, and closing my eyes to reflect on recent confusions in nonfiction writing about "how to transform field observations into effective narratives." Joining the online meeting on time, I attentively listened to the lecture titled "From Observation to Writing: The Application of Fieldwork Methods in Nonfiction Literature." With full concentration, I recorded core insights and case studies such as "the quadrants of observation," "narrative ethics and boundaries in nonfiction," and "the 'breakthrough' moments from raw material to structure." On the margins of the notebook, I jotted down inspiration for essay topics based on life in Kunming. After the lecture, I promptly organized my notes, highlighting key points and questions. I then shared the core takeaways via WeChat voice messages with fellow writer Song Wen and engaged in a ten-minute discussion about the idea of "practicing a 'fieldwork sensibility' in urban spaces."
location: Home Study in Yunda Residential Area, No. 343 Longquan Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province (Online Participation)

Afterward, I washed up, allowing both my body and mind to gradually relax.
location: No. 343 Longquan Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province, in the bedroom and bathroom of the home at Yunda Residential Community.

They reminisced about the fun moments of the past four years, such as late-night chats, rushing to finish papers, and celebrating birthdays. Sun Yuwei gifted handwritten cards and customized bookmarks, while her roommates reciprocated with handmade earrings and other presents. I also requested a one-week extension for the column article nearing its deadline. While waiting for a reply, I distracted myself by flipping through Wang Zengqi’s collection of essays. About 15 minutes later, I received Xu’s response: “Understood, the article isn’t urgent—safety first.” This eased some of the pressure. Feeling hungry afterward, I bought a bowl of tofu flower rice noodles from the neighboring Chenji Zhupin Snack Shop to take away. She detailed her predicament, while Song Wen shared similar early experiences and offered specific advice: 1. Data backup (recommending ‘Nut Cloud’ for real-time synchronization and regular backups on an external hard drive); 2. Equipment selection (recommending cost-effective models and purchasing channels); 3. Risk mindset (encouraging her to view this incident as a necessary lesson for freelancers). The conversation also extended to the loneliness and self-management challenges faced by freelancers. Song Wen’s optimistic and practical sharing provided Sun Yuwei with significant emotional support and technical guidance, noticeably calming her emotions.

Passing by my favorite bookstore, I found it closed on Sundays. I paused for a moment outside the window before walking back home, which took another 25 minutes.

Sun Yuwei carefully noted the key points, making her goals clearer.

The view count had almost stagnated, with few new interactions, and a hint of disappointment and self-doubt quietly surfaced: "Is the content too simple? Or does no one like this quiet style?" She took a deep breath, put down her phone, got up, and drew back the curtains, looking at the rain-drenched green leaves outside the window. After washing up, she changed into a comfortable beige knit sweater and jeans.
location: No. 343 Longquan Road, Yunda Residential Area, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province, China, in the bedroom of the home.

description: Mother had prepared millet porridge and boiled eggs. Sun Yuwei checked her phone again while eating breakfast. At that moment, a message popped up on WeChat from her fellow writer, Song Wen, offering encouragement: "Yuwei, I watched your video—it's so full of texture! This quiet, documentary style is exactly what's rare these days. Don't worry about the initial data; my first few episodes were the same. Keep going!" At the same time, two positive comments appeared under the video. A slight smile touched her lips as she replied to Song Wen and thanked the commenters, gradually feeling more at ease.
location: No. 343 Longquan Road, Yunda Residential Area, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province, China, Dining Room at Home

Sun Yuwei listened attentively, jotting down key points and inspirations from time to time. She realized that the teacher’s discussion of the "leisurely tone" and "expression of personal temperament" resonated deeply with the Cuihu column she was currently conceptualizing. During the break, she quickly noted down a few keywords in her phone's memo app.
location: No. 2, Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province, Yunnan University Donglu Campus, a classroom in Wenyuan Building

She ordered a bowl of mushroom and chicken rice noodles. Perhaps because the emotional turmoil from the morning hadn’t fully subsided, coupled with the pressure of writing, she couldn’t resist ordering a serving of the shop’s signature glutinous rice balls in sweet soybean flour after finishing the noodles. She felt a bit full afterward, but the brief comfort brought by the sweet treat was real.

This served as a preliminary mind map for her formal writing session in the afternoon.
location: No. 2, Cuihu North Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province, Yunnan University Donglu Campus, Library Rest Area

On Monday afternoon, the bookstore was not crowded, quiet and filled with the scent of books.

Opening her laptop, she created a new document, tentatively titling it "Emerald Lake Ripples: The Breath of a City Park." She transformed the mind map she had organized during the midday break into an article outline, then began with personal memories, attempting to blend insights from the weekend, observations from the previous day, and the prose style she had learned in class. The writing process was slow but immersive. Over the course of more than three hours, she completed the main body of the first draft, totaling around two thousand words.
location: No. 2 Xuefu Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province, Sanlian Taofen Bookstore, Second Floor Reading Area

name: On the way home, I received a birthday greeting text message from my father.

Your mom wants to prepare in advance." Reading the message, her heart warmed, and she replied immediately: "Yes, Dad. I’ve been working on an article about Emerald Lake these past two days and just had some inspiration." Her father quickly replied with a "Good" and a thumbs-up emoji. When she arrived home, her mother was in the kitchen preparing dinner.
location: From the Sanlian Taofen Bookstore at No. 2 Xuefu Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province, walk to the residential area of Yunda Community at No. 343 Longquan Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province, to the living room of the home.

Though alone away from home, I completed my fieldwork, work, exploration, and documentation as planned, feeling a sense of inner peace and satisfaction. I look forward to meeting my friend Song Wen in Chengdu tomorrow, then turn off the lights to rest.
location: No. 98 Dongsheng Street, Jinjiang District, Chengdu City, Sichuan Province, Inside the room of POSHPACKER Hostel (Chengdu Taikoo Li Chunxi Road Subway Station Branch)

name: Wake up, wash up, and tidy up personal affairs.
date: From 08:20:00 on August 8, 2025, to 09:00:00 on August 8, 2025.
description: Waking up in the women's six-bed dorm at POSHPACKER Hostel, I faced Chengdu's gloomy sky and the pressure of the approaching deadline. After taking a deep breath, I got up to wash up, tidied the bed, and retrieved my laptop, charger, planner, and fountain pen from the suitcase, placing them into my canvas bag. Checking my phone, I saw a WeChat message from my editor Xu Mingyuan, which heightened my anxiety and prompted me to start working immediately.
location: No. 98 Dongsheng Street, Jinjiang District, Chengdu City, Sichuan Province, POSHPACKER Drag Board Shoes Youth Hostel Travel Hotel, Female Six-Bed Dormitory

name: Breakfast and Preliminary Writing
date: From 09:00:00 on August 8, 2025 to 10:30:00 on August 8, 2025
description: In the hostel's communal kitchen, I prepared a simple breakfast using my own cereal and bananas. Carrying it to a window seat in the common lounge, I opened my laptop to revisit the completed chapters of my food essay. The low murmurs of fellow guests and the tapping of keyboards created a soothing white noise around me. After finishing the meal quickly, I washed the dishes and attempted to find a starting point for the reflection and outlook section, but my thoughts felt sluggish.
location: No. 98 Dongsheng Street, Jinjiang District, Chengdu City, Sichuan Province, POSHPACKER Hostel Travel Hotel, Public Kitchen and Lounge Area

name: Go to the cafe and finish the essay.
date: From 10:30:00 on August 8, 2025 to 12:30:00 on August 8, 2025
description: To achieve a more focused writing environment, I walked from the hostel to Fusheng Coffee on Tangpa Street. After ordering an Americano, I settled into a quiet seat. Immersed in the soothing jazz music and the aroma of coffee, I entered a state of flow. I seamlessly integrated reflections on post-yoga scenes in Kunming with mindful eating, smoothly concluding the essay. After writing the final sentence, I felt a sense of relief akin to exhaustion.
location: No. 37 Tangba Street, Jinjiang District, Chengdu City, Sichuan Province, Fusheng Coffee

name: Looking for lunch and recording stress-related eating.
description: After leaving the café, I walked around in search of lunch and entered Sweetheart Traditional Handmade Ice Jelly Shop. I ordered the signature Three-Fresh Ice Jelly and beef-stuffed flatbread. Before the meal, I noted in my journal: 12:50, before lunch, anxiety level 7/10, a clear craving for sweets. After the meal, I added: 13:15, after eating, anxiety slightly decreased to 6/10. The sugar and carbs brought brief satisfaction and relaxation, but my attention remained focused on the unedited manuscript, fully capturing the observation of eating patterns under stress.
location: No. 55 Tangba Street, Jinjiang District, Chengdu City, Sichuan Province, Sweetheart Xiansheng Traditional Handmade Ice Jelly Shop

name: Return to the youth hostel and revise and polish the manuscript.
description: Walking back to the hostel, I settled into a corner seat in the common area and began revising and polishing the manuscript word by word. In the afternoon, drowsiness and anxiety intertwined, and the craving for brown sugar pearl milk tea grew intense. After struggling for about twenty minutes, I ordered takeout around 15:00. Immediately afterward, I opened a page in my journal with a highlighter to document an instance of emotional eating, recording the time, stressors, and the mental struggle behind placing the order in detail.
location: No. 98 Dongsheng Street, Jinjiang District, Chengdu City, Sichuan Province, POSHPACKER Youth Hostel Travel Hotel, Public Lounge Area

name: Order milk tea, pick up takeout, and record emotional eating.
description: After the food delivery phone rang, I went downstairs to take the brown sugar bubble milk tea from the rider, returned to my seat, inserted a straw, and took a sip. In the emotional eating observation log, I added: 15:40, drinking, instant sweetness and the satisfaction of chewing pearls, but followed by slight stomach bloating and self-blame. Anxiety level rose to 6.5/10 due to self-blame and post-sugar drowsiness. I sipped the milk tea while aimlessly scrolling through phone news to force a break.
location: No. 98 Dongsheng Street, Jinjiang District, Chengdu City, Sichuan Province, POSHPACKER Youth Hostel Travel Hotel, Public Lounge Area and Entrance on the First Floor

name: Final Draft and Submission of Manuscript
date: From 16:00:00 on August 8, 2025, to 17:20:00 on August 8, 2025
description: After finishing the milk tea, I refocused on the screen and conducted a final read-through. I adjusted some wording and punctuation, and after confirming everything was correct, I saved the document as "Sun Yuwei_Dietary Essay 'Negotiation of Taste'_Final Draft_0808." I then sent it to editor Xu Mingyuan via WeChat, along with a note notifying him of the submission. After clicking send, I felt an immense sense of relief, leaning back in my chair and letting out a long sigh.
location: No. 98 Dongsheng Street, Jinjiang District, Chengdu City, Sichuan Province, POSHPACKER Hostel & Travel Hotel, Common Lounge Area

name: Strolling and Urban Micro-Exploration
description: To release the fatigue from prolonged sitting and the excitement after submitting the manuscript, I went out for an aimless stroll along the small streets and alleys around the hostel. Passing by the independent bookstore once again, I paused in front of the wall on Gengjia Alley to admire the graffiti. Then, I walked through the bustling community market in the evening, capturing with my phone the vegetables glistening with water droplets and the people haggling over prices—all of which effectively soothed my mood.
location: The area around Dongsheng Street, Qinglian Upper Street, Gengjia Lane, and Shuyuan Street in Jinjiang District

name: Celebratory dinner and return to the youth hostel
description: Walk to the Xiaomingtang Dandan Sweet Water Noodle Shop on Huaxing East Street, and celebrate the completion of the manuscript with sweet water noodles and Zhong dumplings for dinner. The flavors are authentic, and I enjoy a leisurely meal while jotting in my notebook: 18:50, a reward dinner for finishing the manuscript. The food brings pure, direct joy, anxiety level 1/10. After the meal, I take a slow stroll back to the hostel.
location: No. 63 Huaxing East Street, Jinjiang District, Chengdu City, Sichuan Province, Xiaomingtang Dandan Sweet Water Noodles (Huaxing Street Store)

name: Online Sharing and Organizing Notes
description: Back at the female six-bed dormitory in the hostel, I sent a voice message to my mother, Li Xiulan, to share the good news about completing the manuscript and received her praise. In a small group chat with fellow writers, including Song Wen and other friends, I shared the sense of relief after finishing the draft. Then, I organized the notes, receipts, and photos from my trip to Chengdu, categorizing them into computer folders with labels such as observations, inspirations, and food, to accumulate material for future creative work.
location: No. 98 Dongsheng Street, Jinjiang District, Chengdu City, Sichuan Province, POSHPACKER Hostel Travel Hotel, Female Six-Bed Dormitory

name: Check travel preparations and inform fellow travelers.
description: Final check of travel preparations: Confirm the ID card and the electronic itinerary for tomorrow's return flight to Kunming, MU5844. Place the documents in the inner compartment of the carry-on bag. Check the suitcase to ensure that the gift for Song Wen, the paper tape, and the flower cakes are well-packaged, and that other items are properly stored. Then, send a WeChat message to Song Wen to inform them that everything is ready, and arrange to meet at the airport tomorrow. Await their confirmation reply.
location: No. 98 Dongsheng Street, Jinjiang District, Chengdu City, Sichuan Province, POSHPACKER Hostel & Travel Hotel, Female Six-Bed Dormitory

name: Recording hand account, reading, and staying up late status
description: In a quiet moment, I opened my journal and spent a long time reflecting on and recording the day’s experiences: from morning anxiety, the flow state at the café, the milk tea experiment under pressure, the exhilaration after submission, to the peaceful evening stroll. My handwriting alternated between hurried and relaxed. After finishing the entry, I took out *A Chronicle of Chengdu’s Streets and Alleys* and read for about half an hour. My mind was active but my body was exhausted, achieving the state of staying up late after staying up late to finish a draft.
location: No. 98 Dongsheng Street, Jinjiang District, Chengdu City, Sichuan Province, POSHPACKER Hostel & Travel Hotel, Female Six-Bed Dormitory

name: Pre-sleep Preparation and Bedtime
date: From 23:30:00 on August 8, 2025 to 00:10:00 on August 9, 2025
description: After a quick wash, set the alarm for 7 a.m. tomorrow to allow enough time for the journey to Shuangliu Airport and check-in. Check the locations of the phone, documents, and important items. Turn off the lights and get into bed. In the darkness, feel the physical and mental exhaustion, along with the immense relief after completing tasks and a calm anticipation for tomorrow's journey home. Gradually drift into sleep.
location: No. 98 Dongsheng Street, Jinjiang District, Chengdu City, Sichuan Province, POSHPACKER Drag Board Shoes Youth Hostel Travel Hotel, Female Six-Bed Dormitory

name: Morning Family Preparation and Farewell
date: From 05:30:00 on August 9, 2025, to 06:30:00 on August 9, 2025
description: Sun Yuwei was awakened by the alarm clock, feeling sleep-deprived from staying up late to finish her manuscript the previous night, yet excited about the upcoming trip. She got up, washed up, and performed a final check of her backpack (ID card, plane ticket, phone, power bank, notebook, pen, and a gift for Song Wen). After that, she had a simple breakfast with her parents (milk and bread). Her father reminded her to stay safe, while her mother expressed concern about the weather. Sun Yuwei quickly finished her meal, hugged her parents, and bid them farewell.
location: No. 343, Longquan Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province, in the bedroom and living room of the residential area of Yunda Community.

name: Father drove to Kunming Airport to see me off.
description: Father Sun Mingyuan drove Sun Yuwei to Kunming Changshui International Airport. The roads were clear in the early morning, and the journey took about 30 minutes. Along the way, Sun Yuwei gazed at the familiar scenery outside the window, her heart filled with anticipation and the sorrow of parting. She also sent a leave request to her yoga partner, He Lu, via WeChat.
location: From the residential area of Yunda Community at No. 343 Longquan Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province to the departure level of Terminal 1 at Changshui International Airport, Guandu District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province.

name: Airport waiting, check-in, and boarding.
description: After arriving at the airport, Sun Yuwei bid farewell to her father. She printed her boarding pass (Flight MU5843, window seat) at the self-service check-in counter and passed through security. She bought water at a convenience store near the boarding gate and found a quiet corner to read Shen Congwen's "Random Notes on a Trip to Hunan." Shortly after, boarding began. She entered the cabin, found her window seat, fastened her seatbelt, and prepared for takeoff.
location: Terminal 1 Domestic Departure Hall and Boarding Gates, Changshui International Airport, Guandu District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province

name: During the flight from Kunming to Chengdu
date: From 08:20:00 on August 9, 2025, to 10:00:00 on August 9, 2025.
description: As the plane ascended through the clouds, Sun Yuwei put on her noise-canceling headphones to listen to music. Most of the time, she gazed out the window at the sea of clouds, lost in thought, occasionally jotting down fragmented reflections in her notebook, such as, "The sunlight above the clouds feels more direct than on the ground." During the flight, she dozed off for about twenty minutes. When the flight attendant offered drinks, she asked for warm water, savoring the smooth and steady journey.
location: MU5843 Flight Cabin (Kunming to Chengdu Route)

name: Arrive at Chengdu Shuangliu Airport and collect luggage.
date: From 10:00:00 on August 9, 2025 to 10:30:00 on August 9, 2025
description: The plane landed at Chengdu Shuangliu Airport under overcast skies. Sun Yuwei followed the flow of passengers off the plane and headed to the baggage carousel to retrieve her checked suitcase. While waiting, she sent a WeChat message to her parents to let them know she had arrived safely and checked the subway route from the airport to the youth hostel.
location: Chengdu Shuangliu International Airport Terminal 2 Arrival Hall, Airport North Second Road, Shuangliu District, Chengdu City, Sichuan Province

name: Take the subway to the downtown youth hostel.
description: Sun Yuwei took Line 10 and transferred to Line 3, traveling from Terminal 2 of Shuangliu Airport Station to the Provincial Gymnasium Station. As the subway moved along, she observed the advertisements inside the carriage and the passengers chatting in Sichuan dialect. After exiting the station, she walked for about 10 minutes to a youth hostel near Yulin Road, immersing herself in the city's vibrant flow.
location: Chengdu Metro Line 10 and Line 3 (from Shuangliu Airport Terminal 2 Station to Provincial Gymnasium Station), then walk to Yulin Road.

name: Youth Hostel Check-in, Settling In, and Exploring Lunch Options Nearby
description: Sun Yuwei found the "Xiangmo" Youth Hostel hidden in an old residential area, where the receptionist aunt warmly checked her in. The hostel, renovated from an old house, was artistic and quiet. She settled into a four-bed dormitory and briefly organized her luggage. Later, she explored the area around the hostel and was drawn by the aroma of beef tallow from "Piaoxiang Hotpot." She ordered a small portion of a split-pot hotpot with tripe and duck intestines for lunch, observing the local diners and jotting down in her journal, "My first meal in Chengdu welcomed me with the boiling of hotpot."

participant.name: Front desk auntie at the youth hostel

location: "Xiangmo" Youth Hostel and the nearby Piaoxiang Hotpot Restaurant on Yulin North Road, Yulin Street, Wuhou District, Chengdu City, Sichuan Province

name: Return to the youth hostel for a short rest and plan the afternoon itinerary.
description: After lunch, Sun Yuwei slowly walked back to her hostel room and leaned against the headboard to rest. She used her phone to check the route from the hostel to Kuanzhai Alley (a direct trip on Subway Line 3, taking about 20 minutes) and decided to set off later. She then packed the items she would need for the afternoon (phone, power bank, wallet, notebook, pen, and umbrella) into her small bag.
location: Inside the room of "Alleyway" Youth Hostel, Yulin North Road, Yulin Street, Wuhou District, Chengdu City, Sichuan Province

name: Take the subway to Kuanzhai Alley.
description: Sun Yuwei put on her small backpack and walked from the youth hostel to the Provincial Stadium Station, where she took Metro Line 3 to Kuanzhai Alley. On the subway, she observed the diverse crowds getting on and off, feeling the rhythm of the city.
location: From the "Alleyway" Youth Hostel at Yulin North Road, Yulin Street, Wuhou District, Chengdu City, Sichuan Province, to the Kuanzhai Alley Station on Metro Line 3.

name: Immersive Exploration of the Kuanzhai Alley Scenic Area
description: Sun Yuwei walked from the subway station to Kuanzhai Alley, first turning into the relatively quiet Jing Alley to view the brick and stone cultural wall, then entering a side alley connecting Kuanzhai Alley to avoid the hustle and bustle of the main street. At the "Panda Post Office" cultural and creative shop, she carefully selected elegantly designed ink wash panda and Sichuan opera-themed postcards, stamped them with special postmarks, and immersed herself in the cultural atmosphere of the scenic area.
location: Wide and Narrow Alley Scenic Area (focusing on Well Alley and side alleys), Qingyang District, Chengdu City, Sichuan Province

name: Sitting Idly in an Old Teahouse: Observations and Notes
description: After exploring, Sun Yuwei sat down in the outdoor bamboo chair area of the "He Ming" old teahouse in the side alley of Kuanzhai Alley, ordering a cup of Bi Tan Piao Xue. The fragrance of jasmine wafted with the rising steam as she observed the chatting elderly, tourists taking photos, and the play of light and shadow in the alley—time seemed to slow down. She took out the postcard she had just bought and wrote her feelings of the moment on the back, savoring the leisurely time.
location: In the "He Ming" old teahouse's outdoor bamboo chair area within the Kuanzhai Alley scenic spot, Qingyang District, Chengdu City, Sichuan Province.

name: On the way back to the youth hostel, I confirmed tomorrow's appointment with my friend Song Wen.
description: Sun Yuwei left the teahouse and took Metro Line 3 back to the youth hostel. On the subway, she sent a message to her friend Song Wen via WeChat, informing him that she had settled in at the Yulin Road Youth Hostel and sharing her experience of visiting Kuanzhai Alley that day. She confirmed their meeting at the Wuzao Café (Zijing North Road, Wuhou District) at 10 a.m. the next day. Song Wen quickly replied in the affirmative, and after a brief chat, they agreed to meet tomorrow.
location: Chengdu Metro Line 3 (from Kuanzhai Alley Station to Provincial Gymnasium Station) and on the way back to the youth hostel

name: Enjoy authentic local snacks for dinner near the youth hostel.
description: After returning to Yulin Road, Sun Yuwei found the "Yulin Wonton" shop, recommended by the hostel's front desk as a favorite among locals. She ordered a bowl of red oil wontons and a serving of chilled rice cake. The wontons had thin, delicate wrappers and tender fillings, with fragrant red oil that was not overpowering. The chilled rice cake was refreshingly sweet and helped cut through the richness. She quietly enjoyed the meal, savoring the authentic flavors of Chengdu's local snacks.
location: "Yulin Wonton" Snack Shop, Yulin Street, Wuhou District, Chengdu City, Sichuan Province

name: Packing luggage, recording in a journal, and preparing gifts in the evening.
description: Sun Yuwei returned to her hostel room, first washing up and changing into comfortable pajamas. Then, she sat at the desk and opened her journal, meticulously recording everything from the day: the reluctance of leaving home in the morning, the thoughts during the flight, her impressions of Yulin Road, discoveries in Kuanzhai Alley, the leisurely atmosphere of the teahouse, the taste of the wontons, and so on, attaching the postcards she had purchased. After that, she took out the gifts she would bring to Song Wen the next day (Kunming flower cakes and a collection of Yunnan prose) from her suitcase and placed them beside her backpack.
location: Inside the room of "Xiangmo" Youth Hostel, Yulin North Road, Yulin Street, Wuhou District, Chengdu City, Sichuan Province

name: Public Rest Area for Reading and Relaxation
description: After recording, Sun Yuwei took "Random Notes on a Trip to Hunan" and her water cup to the common lounge area of the hostel, where soft sofas and warm lighting awaited. Only one foreign backpacker was there, using a laptop in the corner. She found a quiet spot to sit down and read in peace, enjoying a tranquil evening alone during her travels.
location: "Alleyway" Youth Hostel Public Lounge Area, Yulin North Road, Yulin Street, Wuhou District, Chengdu City, Sichuan Province

name: Pre-sleep Preparation and Bedtime
description: Sun Yuwei returned to her room to prepare for bed: checking the doors and windows, charging her phone, and setting an alarm for 8:00 AM the next morning. She did a few simple stretches to relieve the fatigue from a day of walking, then lay in bed listening to the sounds of the city at night outside the window. Though she felt a slight unfamiliarity with the new environment, it was overshadowed by a sense of satisfaction from the day’s explorations and anticipation for meeting friends tomorrow. Gradually, she drifted off to sleep.
location: Inside the room of "Alleyway" Youth Hostel, Yulin North Road, Yulin Street, Wuhou District, Chengdu City, Sichuan Province

location: No. 15 Yulin North Road, Wuhou District, Chengdu City, Sichuan Province, Xiangmo Youth Hostel, Public Lounge Area

name: Have dinner together and continue the conversation.
description: Having dinner at Yulin Chuanchuanxiang, continuing the conversation amidst the lively atmosphere, Song Wen encouraged maintaining the writing style and discussed the possibility of future collaboration on an article titled 'A Tale of Two Cities'.

location: No. 26-23, Yulin Street, Wuhou District, Chengdu City, Sichuan Province, outside Yulin Chuanchuanxiang (Yulin Main Store)

location: No. 15 Yulin North Road, Wuhou District, Chengdu City, Sichuan Province, Xiangmo Youth Hostel, Public Lounge Area

location: No. 15 Yulin North Road, Wuhou District, Chengdu City, Sichuan Province, Xiangmo Youth Hostel, Washroom and 4-Bed Dormitory

location: No. 15 Yulin North Road, Wuhou District, Chengdu City, Sichuan Province, Xiangmo Youth Hostel, 4-bed dormitory

name: Waking up and getting ready in the morning at the hostel.
description: Waking up naturally to the sound of rain at Chengdu Xiangmo Youth Hostel, I tidied up the bed and personal belongings, reminiscing about the meeting with Song Wen from the previous evening. After washing up, I had a simple breakfast of toast and milk in the common area, preparing for check-out and the day's itinerary.
location: Yulin West Road, Wuhou District, Chengdu City, Sichuan Province, Xiangmo Youth Hostel

name: Go to Fangsuo Commune
description: With a canvas bag on my back, I walked from the hostel to the subway station under an umbrella, took the subway for about 30 minutes to Taikoo Li, listening to music and observing the cityscape along the way, feeling calm yet filled with anticipation for exploration.
location: From the Yulin West Road Xiangmo Youth Hostel in Wuhou District, Chengdu City, Sichuan Province, to No. 8 Zhongshamao Street, Jinjiang District, Chengdu Taikoo Li.

name: Immersive Exploration and Rest Record at Fangsuo Bookstore
date: From 10:00:00 on August 11, 2025, to 12:40:00 on August 11, 2025
description: Explore the cave-like space of Fangsuo Bookstore, take photos that capture the sense of space, and focus on browsing books in literature, art, design, and urban strolling studies. Afterwards, order a hot Americano in the bookstore's café area to relax, use a notebook to record impressions and keywords of the bookstore's design, and add sticky notes to new books.
location: No. 8 Zhongshamao Street, Jinjiang District, Chengdu, Sichuan Province, B1 Floor, Chengdu Taikoo Li, Fangsuo Bookstore and its internal coffee area

name: Try the Pea and Pork Noodles for lunch.
description: Walk to the noodle shop in the alley near Taikoo Li, order a bowl of pea and minced pork noodles to taste. The noodles are chewy, and the minced pork and peas have a unique texture. Meanwhile, observe the diners in the shop and the pedestrians outside the window.
location: No. 41 Youlou Street, Jinjiang District, Chengdu City, Sichuan Province, Youlou Street Sujiao Zajiang Noodles (Chunxi Road Taikoo Li Pedestrian Street Branch)

name: Walking Tour to Visit Doku Hon'ya Bookstore and Select Gifts
description: After the meal, I walked for about 25 minutes to the Dubenwu Bookstore, observing the old street scenery along the way, such as green plants, aged walls, and design shops. At the bookstore, I explored books on social sciences, philosophy, and urban studies, discussing the owner’s book selection philosophy. I purchased Taiwanese literature books and works on Chengdu’s history. Later, at the adjacent cultural and creative shop, I selected postcards featuring old maps of Chengdu or panda ink paintings, as well as engraved bookmarks as gifts for friends.
location: Qinglian Upper Street (near Shuijin Street), Jinjiang District, Chengdu City, Sichuan Province, Dubenwu Independent Bookstore and the adjacent cultural and creative grocery store.

name: Return to the hostel to pack up and check out.
description: Take the subway back to Xiangmo Youth Hostel, quickly pack your luggage and check for any missing items, then check out at the front desk and bid farewell to the staff with a smile.

participant.relation: Front desk staff at a youth hostel

name: Go to Chengdu Shuangliu International Airport
description: Dragging my suitcase, I walked from the hostel to the subway station and took the subway for about 50 minutes to Terminal T2 of Shuangliu Airport. During the journey, I confirmed the check-in information for flight MU5844 and selected my seat in advance.
location: From Yulin West Road Xiangmo Youth Hostel, Wuhou District, Chengdu City, Sichuan Province to Terminal 2 of Shuangliu International Airport.

name: Check in at the airport and wait for the flight.
description: Print the boarding pass and check in luggage at the self-service check-in counter at the airport. After passing through security, rest near the boarding gate. Use the phone memo to record today's bookstore observations and key points from conversations, and prepare for journaling. Meanwhile, send a WeChat message to family to inform them that you have arrived at the airport.
location: Terminal 2, Shuangliu International Airport, Chengdu City, Sichuan Province

name: The flight returns to Kunming.
description: I took China Eastern Airlines flight MU5844 from Chengdu back to Kunming, which was slightly delayed due to traffic control and took off around 20:10. During the flight, I gazed out the window at the clouds and night sky, reminiscing about my trip to Chengdu, ate the in-flight meal, and read the preface of a new book.
location: China Eastern Airlines Flight MU5844 (Chengdu Shuangliu - Kunming Changshui)

name: Arrive in Kunming and take the Airport Express.
description: The plane landed at Kunming Changshui Airport. After retrieving the checked luggage, I purchased a ticket for Airport Express Line 1 heading toward Kunming Railway Station. The bus journey took about 50 minutes, during which I gazed out the window at the familiar night scenery of Kunming.
location: Kunming Changshui International Airport and Airport Express Line 1 Bus in Yunnan Province

name: Take a taxi home from the bus station.

As we ate, we shared our summer experiences: Sun Yuwei’s published column and her trip to Chengdu, Zhao Xiaowen’s amusing stories from her internship at a publishing house, and Zhou Lin’s mix of anticipation and anxiety about her upcoming life in Shenzhen. We reminisced about our four years of college, dreamed about the future, and made a promise to stay in touch despite living in different cities, striving to reunite at least once a year. The atmosphere was warm yet tinged with a hint of melancholy. After dinner, the three of us took a stroll along the familiar Wenlin Street, passing by our frequent haunts—'Wheatfield Bookstore' and 'Authentic Milk Tea Shop'—and took photos to commemorate the moment. At the street corner, we hugged, bid farewell, and wished each other well. Watching her roommates walk away, Sun Yuwei felt a wave of reluctance, but even stronger was her unwavering hope for their futures.

Then, carrying her homemade snack and a cup of black tea, she went out to the balcony. The rain had stopped, the clouds had parted, and a hint of golden sunset light peeked through in the west. The air was fresh and cool. Slowly savoring the fruits of her labor, she decided to head out as planned.

name: Commuting and Urban Corner Photography Exploration
description: Sun Yuwei checked the camera battery, took an umbrella, and went out. She walked for five minutes to the bus stop near her residential area and took Bus 100 to Cuihu Park. There weren’t many people on the bus, and she gazed out the window at the wet streets. After about 25 minutes, she got off at Cuihu South Road Station. Upon entering Cuihu Park, she carried her portable camera for a photography exploration. After the rain, there were few visitors in the park. She avoided the main paths and focused on details: the moss at the base of walls, washed especially green by the rain; the small grass growing between stone slabs; and the water droplets on lotus leaves. Later, she strolled to Qingyun Street and Xiansheng Slope (near 152 Wenlin Street). In a quiet alley, she discovered fallen bougainvillea petals hanging from a wall, spread over the damp bluestone pavement. She crouched down and captured this scene full of melancholy and vitality from a low angle.

name: Bookstore Visits and Gaining Inspiration for New Columns

Sun Yuwei nodded and asked if there were any photography collections on urban micro-ecology or the aesthetics of ruins. Uncle Qin thought for a moment, then took a copy of *Moss: The Microscopic Forest of the Silent World* and *Abandoned Gardens* from the shelf. Sun Yuwei sat down in the reading area to browse through them. The former gave her a more scientific understanding of the moss she had photographed that afternoon. Immediately, she jotted down an idea in her notebook: the "City Corners" column could perhaps be subdivided into "Nature" and "Humanities" sections. Before leaving, she thanked Uncle Qin and purchased the book *Moss*.

description: Arriving at Kunming Station, I collected my ticket as a souvenir and went through security. Finding the waiting area, I put on my headphones to listen to my travel playlist and double-checked the information for train D****. After ticket inspection, I boarded the bullet train, found my window seat F, and settled my luggage.

name: Train Journey: Reading, Contemplating, and Observing
date: From 08:30:00 on October 5, 2025, to 10:40:00 on October 5, 2025
description: The train departs on schedule. I first immerse myself in the chapter on Bai architecture and the texture of the ancient city in *In Search of Dali's Culture*. Outside the window, the scenery shifts gradually from urban landscapes to the highland basins. Closing the book, I let my thoughts wander around the themes of "light and shadow" and "silence," jotting down keywords in my notebook. Midway, I close my eyes to rest, sharing my travel ideas with my online friend Wenzi and posting photos of the clouds outside the window in my close friends' group chat. Around 11:00, I purchase and eat a light high-speed rail bento. After the meal, gazing at the increasingly clear outline of the Cangshan Mountains in the distance, my sense of mission for "work-integrated travel" gradually becomes clearer.
location: Inside the D**** high-speed train carriage from Kunming to Dali

name: Arrival at Dali Station and Exiting the Station
description: The train pulled into Dali Station. Stepping off with luggage in hand, I was greeted by air that was moist and crisp, distinct from Kunming’s, with dazzling sunlight. Following the crowd toward the exit, my mood officially shifted into "Dali mode."
location: Dali Station, Weishan Road, Dali City, Dali Bai Autonomous Prefecture, Yunnan Province

name: Take a taxi to the ancient town homestay.
description: Queue up for a taxi at the station. The ride takes about 40 minutes (including possible waiting time and slow driving within the ancient town). Tell the driver your destination is "Bijingsuan Inn." Along the way, you'll pass through the new city, with the picturesque scenery of Cangshan Mountain and Erhai Lake unfolding before your eyes. The driver enthusiastically talks about the weather and suggests taking precautions against sunburn.
location: Dali Station Exit, Weishan Road, Dali City, Dali Bai Autonomous Prefecture, Yunnan Province

name: Check-in and Settling In
description: Arrived at the inn. It is a quiet courtyard in Bai ethnic style, lush with greenery. After checking in, I got a room on the first floor. The room is simple and clean, with a small window facing the inner courtyard. I quickly unpacked and arranged my creative tools—camera, journal, books—on the desk, creating a familiar "work corner."
location: Dali Bijingxuan Inn, Pingdeng Road, Dali City, Dali Bai Autonomous Prefecture, Yunnan Province

name: Lunch: Taste Weishan Braised Meat with Rice Noodles
description: After settling in, I felt ravenous. According to Amap's search, there was a time-honored Ersi noodle shop nearby. I walked for about five minutes to get there. I ordered a bowl of their signature braised meat Ersi noodles—the broth was savory, and the noodles were soft and chewy. Sitting in a corner of the small shop, I observed the local customers coming and going, using my taste buds to form my first impression of Dali.
location: Yunnan Province, Dali Bai Autonomous Prefecture, Dali City, Pingdeng Road, Weishan Braised Meat with Rice Noodles (Ten-Year-Old Shop)

name: Afternoon Rest and Reading
description: Back in the guesthouse room. Sunlight filters through the gaps in the curtains. Deciding to take a short half-hour nap to ease the fatigue from the journey. Upon waking, feeling refreshed and clear-headed. Leaning against the headboard, I continue reading "In Search of Dali’s Culture," focusing on the sections about daily life in the ancient city and the traces of time, to better prepare myself with knowledge for the evening exploration.
location: Inside the room of Dali Bijingxuan Inn, Pingdeng Road, Dali City, Dali Bai Autonomous Prefecture, Yunnan Province

name: Evening Exploration of the Ancient City: A Poem of Light and Shadow
description: The prime creative hours begin. Carrying only a camera and a notebook, I step out lightly. A 15-minute walk from the inn leads me deep into the quiet alleys of Yincang Road and Yeyu Road, deliberately avoiding the hustle and bustle of the main streets. The slanting western sun casts a golden glow over ancient walls, stone-paved paths, and wooden doors, stretching long shadows across the ground. Like a quiet detective, I capture with my lens the fading colors of painted door lintels, the vitality of small flowers atop walls, and the silhouettes of elderly people sitting leisurely. My ears collect the sounds of flowing water, rustling winds, and faint echoes of the city. In my notebook, I sketch not just places but fleeting emotions: "Light and shadow are the brushes of time, painting subtraction on weathered walls." "The polished brass rings silently count countless dawns and dusks."
location: Within the ancient city of Dali, Yincang Road, Yeyu Road, and the surrounding lanes

name: Dinner: Light Vegetarian Meal
description: I strolled down Yeyu Road and found the planned vegetarian restaurant. It took about a 10-minute walk from the exploration area to get there. I ordered a stir-fried mushroom dish and a bowl of pumpkin porridge, both light and warm in flavor, specially prepared to soothe a potentially sensitive stomach. In the tranquil dining environment, I savored the visual feast from the day.
location: No. 93 Yeyu Road, Dali City, Dali Bai Autonomous Prefecture, Yunnan Province, Wuxiangsong Vegetarian Kitchen

name: Returning to the inn after a walk.
description: After dinner, as the sky gradually darkened, the ancient city began to light up. We slowly retraced our steps along the path we had taken earlier, walking for about 20 minutes. Feeling the transition of the ancient city from the vibrant theater of daylight to the tranquil serenity of the night, our hearts settled into a peaceful calm.
location: On the way back from Wuxiang Song Vegetarian Kitchen to Dali Bijingxuan Inn, the destination is Dali Bijingxuan Inn, Pingdeng Road, Dali City, Dali Bai Autonomous Prefecture, Yunnan Province.

name: Evening Organization: Sorting, Planning, and Checking In
description: Returning to the inn. First, I made a video call to my parents to let them know I was safe, showing them the room and the small courtyard to set their minds at ease. Then, I brought my journal to the courtyard and, under the warm yellow light, organized the fragmented inspirations I had captured in the evening, forming a preliminary writing outline on the theme of "everyday expressions of traditional continuity." Next, I used my phone to check the map and plan the detailed route for tomorrow’s cycling trip along the Erhai Lake ecological corridor: starting from Caicun Wharf, passing through Panxi and Gusheng Village, and arriving near Haise Park, marking several spots where I wanted to stop for photos and to soak in the atmosphere.
location: Yunnan Province, Dali Bai Autonomous Prefecture, Dali City, Pingdeng Road, Dali Bijingxuan Inn Room and Courtyard

name: Washing, Relaxation, and Bedtime
description: My stomach feels fine thanks to careful eating, but to ensure energy for tomorrow, I decide to turn in early. After a simple wash-up, I soak my feet in hot water to ease the fatigue from walking. Lying in bed, I reflect on this fulfilling day: from the morning farewell in Kunming, to the wandering thoughts on the bullet train, to stepping into Dali, checking in, and exploring the ancient town with my footsteps and senses… A sense of calm and abundant creative anticipation envelops me. I turn off the light and drift into peaceful sleep in the unfamiliar quiet.
location: In the room of Dali Bijingxuan Inn, Pingdeng Road, Dali City, Dali Bai Autonomous Prefecture, Yunnan Province, China.

name: Morning Preparation and Inn Breakfast
date: From 07:00:00 on October 6, 2025, to 08:15:00 on October 6, 2025
description: Waking up naturally in the inn room, I freshened up and prepared my cycling gear, including my phone, camera, sketchbook, portable watercolors, journal, pens, sun protection items, water, and mooncakes. I sent a WeChat message to my mother to let her know I was safe and wish her a happy Mid-Autumn Festival. Afterward, I enjoyed a simple breakfast of white porridge, steamed buns, and pickles in the inn's courtyard. I also consulted with the innkeeper about renting a bike and booking a ride-hailing service from Haise Park to Dali Station.
location: Near Pingdeng Road, Dali Ancient City, Dali City, Dali Bai Autonomous Prefecture, Yunnan Province, Jingyu Inn Rooms and Courtyard/Restaurant

name: Head to the starting point of the Erhai Ecological Corridor.
date: From 08:15:00 on October 6, 2025 to 09:00:00 on October 6, 2025
description: Walk about 25 minutes from the inn to a bicycle rental shop near Erhai Gate, select a lightweight mountain bike and complete the rental process. Confirm that the rental supports returning the bike at Haise Park (where the rental shop will send someone to retrieve it), and pay the deposit and rental fee. Then, ride for about 20 minutes to reach the entrance of the ecological corridor at Caicun Pier, officially starting the lakeside cycling tour.
location: Near Erhai Gate in Dali City, Dali Bai Autonomous Prefecture, Yunnan Province, Redwood Tree Bicycle Rental Shop

name: Cycling and Scouting along the Erhai Lake Ecological Corridor (Morning Session)
description: Cycling northward along the Erhai Lake Ecological Corridor from Caicun Wharf to near Xizhou, the entire journey spans approximately 18 kilometers. Under the sunlight, the surface of Erhai Lake sparkles with shimmering ripples, while the silhouette of the Cangshan Mountains on the opposite shore stands out clearly. I stopped multiple times to capture images of red-billed gulls, reeds, and Bai ethnic villages with my camera. In my notebook, I jotted down keywords such as "the sound of wind rustling through willow groves resembles silk." At the observation deck, I sketched the outlines of distant mountains and the shadows of clouds in my sketchbook. Though my legs felt slightly sore during the ride, my spirits remained light and cheerful.
location: Dali City, Dali Bai Autonomous Prefecture, Yunnan Province, Erhai Ecological Corridor (Caicun Wharf to Xizhou Section)

name: Lunch, Strolling, and Resting in Xizhou Ancient Town
description: From the exit of the ecological corridor, it takes about a 5-minute walk to enter the core area of Xizhou Ancient Town. Purchase a savory Xizhou Posu Baba at the Zongchuanfang Xizhou Posu Baba shop, and enjoy a bowl of Liangji Mixian (cold chicken rice noodles) at a nearby local eatery while observing tourists and elderly Bai people. Visit the Yan Family Courtyard Museum to learn about the architectural details of the Bai-style residence, such as the "three wings and one screen wall" layout, as well as the wood carving craftsmanship. Afterwards, take a break at a street-side independent café by ordering an Americano, update your travel journal, and report the progress of your fieldwork to editor Xu Mingyuan via WeChat.
location: Sifang Street and its vicinity in Xizhou Town, Dali City, Dali Bai Autonomous Prefecture, Yunnan Province, including Zongchuanfang Xizhou Posu Baba Shop, Yan Family Courtyard Museum, and a certain café.

name: Continue cycling to Haise Park and return the bike.
description: After returning to the car pick-up point from Xizhou, continue cycling along the ecological corridor for about 6 kilometers towards Haise Park. With the lake breeze brushing against your face, enjoy the scenery of Cangshan Mountain and Erhai Lake, and slow down to take in the vastness and tranquility with your eyes. Arrive at the designated bike return point near Haise Park and hand over the bike to the rental staff.
location: Eryuan Ecological Corridor (Xizhou to Haise Park Section) and the Return Point near the Entrance of Haise Ecological Park

name: Mid-Autumn Reflection and Material Organization at Haise Park
description: On a quiet bench facing Erhai Lake in Haise Park, I first finished the mooncakes to complete the Mid-Autumn ritual alone in a foreign land. Then, I systematically organized the materials from the whole day: browsing and categorizing photos from the camera, connecting scattered notes into coherent paragraphs in my journal, attempting to describe the change from 'sharp to soft light and shadow' in words, and adding lake blue and grayish-blue watercolor tones to the morning sketches. During this time, I shared photos and voice messages with my online friend 'Wenzi,' describing the state of being 'physically exhausted but spiritually fulfilled.'
location: Yunnan Province, Dali Bai Autonomous Prefecture, Dali City, Xizhou Town, Seaside Ecological Park, Scenic Viewing Bench

location: No. 261, Weishan Road, Dali City, Dali Bai Autonomous Prefecture, Yunnan Province, Dali Railway Station

description: Taking the high-speed train from Dali Station to Kunming Station, the journey takes about 2 hours and 25 minutes. Sitting by the window, watching the scenery swiftly recede outside, I connected the natural imagery of Dali (the light of Erhai Lake, the clouds over Cangshan Mountain, the breeze along the corridor) with the urban memories of Kunming (the willows of Cuihu Lake, the walls of the old streets), and inspiration emerged. I jotted down keywords and metaphors in my phone's memo. During the latter half of the journey, I took a short nap for about 20 minutes.

I took a hot shower, changed into sportswear, placed my cycling clothes in the laundry basket, and ate some fruit to replenish energy.
location: No. 343 Longquan Road, Wuhua District, Kunming City, Yunnan Province, in the living room and bedroom of the home in the Yunda residential community.

At the same time, deepen the inspiration from the train ride and contemplate how to blend "Dali's natural breath" with "Kunming's urban pulse" in the article. After working up a light sweat, walk slowly back home in about 10 minutes.

During dinner with my mother, I collected feedback—she praised the seasoning but suggested soaking the chestnuts beforehand and dry-frying the mushrooms first. After dinner, I took a walk with my mother in the neighborhood, where we discussed optimization techniques in detail. Based on the feedback, I made a second attempt, refining the process (soaking the chestnuts in warm water and microwaving them for 2 minutes; dry-frying the mushrooms without oil until they shrank). The final product showed significant improvement in color, aroma, taste, and presentation, so I took a photo to document the "optimized version." Completed the first trial and optimization of the recipe.

description: Sun Yuwei was working on her prose column in the reading area on the second floor of the Sanlian Taofen Bookstore, focusing on writing a chapter about 'Urban Memories and Paternal Emotions'. Ultimately, I corrected three subtle typos and several punctuation errors. 2. Format Consistency: I reviewed and ensured that the fonts, font sizes, line spacing, and margins for all titles, body text, and citations were completely uniform throughout the book. I also adjusted the automatic updating of the table of contents. 3. Final Version Generation: After saving all the changes, I saved a copy as a PDF document named "Whispers of Cang'er, Mountains of Our Fathers_Final Version_20251226." Upon completion, I let out a long sigh of relief and sent the final PDF via WeChat to my supervisor, Professor Wu Mingyuan, and the editor, Xu Mingyuan, along with a brief completion report.
